decision: Reuse the previous study's F# model unchanged as baseline
options_considered: Rewrite model; fork and edit; reference as a project
rationale: Preserves the previous scenarios as comparison baselines (mission 18); regression test reproduces the previous $3.56M anchor capital

decision: Replace ratio hiring triggers with skill pools and workload thresholds
options_considered: Keep ratios; pure fractional capacity; pools with 0.75 FTE hiring threshold
chosen: Pools with threshold and fractional residual at a 50% premium
rationale: Ratios were stand-ins for drivers (OPS); threshold avoids hiring whole people for fragments

decision: Control admissibility test for live money
options_considered: Two people + reviewer; three people before gate acceptance (CNV-GOV-003)
chosen: Three distinct authorised people and reconciliation outside the payment chain
rationale: Unbound CNV-GOV-003; ADV2-004; sponsor-provided third person reported as transferred work

chosen: 1.5x base; 2-3x upside to be earned by measurement

options_considered: One optimistic and one conservative case; two scope bases
chosen: MSP base and full-scope (LYR) base reported side by side
rationale: They are different scopes, not different optimism (ADV2-002)

options_considered: Premium hours only; employees carry all; employees carry half
chosen: 50% of the operations December excess carried by year-round release-capable employees
rationale: Temps cannot release (OPS; previous report 03); share is an assumption

chosen: Equity need as headline with debt-financed trough and NPV alongside

options_considered: Count as eliminated; exclude and report
chosen: Exclude from servicer savings and report in a transfer ledger and hidden-cost ledger

options_considered: Free; LYR caused cost; allocated share plus licence
chosen: 45% of a $300k capability plus a $60k licence (MSP base); LYR $0.27M caused cost (full-scope base); cost-plus licence as failure case
rationale: Shared resources are not free (mission); no published licence terms

options_considered: Conventional; product-first; customer-funded; narrow; partnership; founder-led; hybrid
chosen: Gated founder-led path with design partner and measured build (gates 1-2 before build spend); narrow service only as evidence, not funding
rationale: Lowest equity need and earliest profitability among admissible paths; staged gates cap the cost of being wrong
